mn18:1.2: At one time the Buddha was living amongst the Sakyans, near Kapilavatthu, in the Banyan Park.
mn18:2.1: Then, after dressing in the morning and taking his bowl and robe, the Blessed One entered Kapilavatthu for alms.
mn18:2.2: After going for alms in Kapilavatthu and returning from almsround after his meal, he went to the Great Grove to pass the day.
